title: Civic Action Scorecard Planner
homeIntro: The Civic Action Scorecard is Miami Dade College's menu of 124 civic actions, each worth points. Reach Bronze (100), Silver (200), or Gold (300); awards are granted by iCED through EngageMDC once you submit your documentation there.

phases.name: Start
phases.tagline: Get informed across all five areas: online, under an hour each
phases.why: Four to six short actions in every area, all doable from a phone or laptop, so your first Bronze points come from the whole scorecard rather than one corner of it.

phases.name: Bronze
phases.tagline: Broaden and show up: the rest of the online basics, plus visits, contacts, donations, and one-hour events
phases.why: With a taste of every area, finish the online basics and start showing up in person: a meeting, a market, a donation, a one-hour event.

phases.name: Silver
phases.tagline: Commit: week-long habits, five-hour service, memberships, trainings, a book
phases.why: With Bronze behind you, these longer commitments build depth: habits kept for a week, five hours of service, memberships, trainings, and a book.

phases.name: Gold
phases.tagline: Lead and build: speeches, poll work, leadership programs, hosting, presenting, projects
phases.why: By now you have the experience to lead: give the speech, work the polls, host the meeting, present the project you built.

floorNote: {category} has fewer starter actions; the rest arrive in later phases.
credit: Built by Daniel Llobet (School for Advanced Studies, MDC Wolfson) as a student project. Questions about the scorecard itself go to iCED at iCED@mdc.edu.
privacy: If you sign in, your progress is stored in a Firebase project owned by Daniel Llobet on Google Cloud. Only you can read it. Delete it any time from the account menu. This is not an MDC or iCED system.
